criteria.text: A clean upstream checkout at the pinned revision runs `build:rhythm-embedded` and emits an artifact whose `manifest.json` names that exact revision, the agreed `electronMajor`, and the three required entry points; no adjacent Rhythm checkout is needed.
criteria.test_id: issue-1526-c1: a clean upstream checkout emits the pinned revision, Electron major, and three entry points without Rhythm

criteria.text: Running the builder twice on the same pinned inputs produces identical `integrity` digests, or the nondeterministic fields are explicitly documented and excluded from the seal.
criteria.test_id: issue-1526-c2: identical pinned inputs reproduce identical integrity digests

criteria.text: Building from a dirty working tree either fails or sets `dirty: true`; every file in the emitted tree appears in `integrity`, and the tree contains no symlink, no absolute path and no excluded developer/user data.
criteria.test_id: issue-1526-c3: dirty sources cannot be sealed clean and emitted trees are sealed, contained, and private-data free

criteria.text: The artifact contains the applicable MIT/CC0/Apache-2.0 notices for the shipped inventory, covered by `integrity` so they cannot drift from the code; a missing or unlicensed asset fails the build. Asset size baseline is recorded for later package comparison.
criteria.test_id: issue-1526-c4: shipped assets have an integrity-covered license inventory and recorded size baseline

criteria.text: The upstream adapter/state test suite still passes at the pinned revision, preserving task IDs, parent/worker relationships, repository/checkout grouping and local archive/viewed state; before/after source-store evidence shows no harness writes.
criteria.reason: UNVERIFIED: run the adapter/state suite at the exact pinned source revision and capture before/after evidence using synthetic disposable stores only. This contract run must not inspect or modify real user harness stores.
